title: Agata Forest Park — Matsumoto City Official Tourism Website

facts.fact: The park contains the former Matsumoto High School wooden Western-style building, a Japanese garden pond and Himalayan cedar avenues.
facts.excerpt: Its Japanese garden pond and Himalayan cedar-lined avenue

facts.fact: The park includes a lawn called Peace Plaza that is suitable for a rest and outdoor recreation.
facts.excerpt: the spacious lawn area known as "Peace Plaza"

facts.fact: Its address is Agata3-chome in Matsumoto, a different area from the castle and former Kaichi School.

notes: Official page actually fetched and the named passages read; raw response and extracted text retained outside Git. Route choices and priorities are original editorial advice. No personal visit, demand ranking, guaranteed mountain view, price or timetable is claimed.
